cross_part_candidates.scope: Every distinct source-instance pair has a disposition for every declared local-geometry template; unresolved specifications are retained

mechanical_validation.scope: No common placement, collision, holding, elastic engagement or load qualification

part_capabilities.scope: Finite measured geometry, physical resources, potential modes and explicit residual source regions; independent scope is published

path_validation.scope: Assembly and insertion paths remain Simulate work

reference_assembly.scope: Attributed reference uses and configuration-bound conflicts, separate from potential compatibility

source_registry.scope: Captured unchanged source bytes and separate source-instance identities

variant_design_execution.scope: Build publishes consumable capabilities; Simulate search and interactive assembly are not implemented

scope: Independent finite geometry requirements and complete pose-independent candidate template coverage; no solved assembly
